methodology: Executive positions are the vote the national Executive publicly requested on each topic. Vote IDs match keys inside src/data/votaciones.json. Vote coding: A = affirmative, N = negative, ABS = abstention, undefined/null = absent.
source: Public record — presidential vetoes, official communications, ministerial statements, Casa Rosada press releases.
